_comment: wave 36: tpoint_direction via the tgeo scalar fold + a NEW bool-gated out-param-double finalize (out_param_scalar). The windowed tgeompoint sequence's overall azimuth: tpoint_direction(Temporal*, double* out) returns a validity bool and writes the direction to the out-param; the out-param double is the result (0 when the flag is false). Reuses the proven tgeo windowed builder; only the value_compute differs (no new template). Probe in v17: collinear NE points -> 0.785398 rad (pi/4), ok=1, on both continuous and discrete sequences.

operators.comment_one_liner: tpoint_direction (double via out-param) - the azimuth/direction of the windowed temporal point.
